title: Stock Futures Fall as Trump’s Europe Tariffs Weigh on Sentiment
summary: Futures on the Euro Stoxx 50 slumped 1.2% in early trading, while those on the S&P 500 dropped 0.8%.  Trump on Saturday announced a 10% tariff as of Feb. 1 on goods from European countries that have rallied to support Greenland in the face of US threats to seize the semi-autonomous Danish territory.
